subject: Phased capacity transition & change order request
messages:
From: Lydia Ramos <lydia@aperture.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aperture Analytics Procurement <procurement@aperture.ai>
Date: Sun, 4 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: phased capacity uplift + SLA transition (change order)

Hi Tessa,

We need to formalize an addition to our current Order Form to cover a phased capacity uplift for Q3 and a short-term transition SLA while we migrate two production services to the Dedicated pool. Procurement has attached the formal approval PDF and a high-level change request (attached).

Key asks:
- Add 400 GPU-hours/month for 3 months starting 2025-07-01, with a phased ramp (50% in week 1, 100% by week 3).
- Temporary 99.5% availability SLA for the transition window (we'll revert to standard SLA after cutover).
- Pro-rate invoice for the ramp month and an accelerated payment schedule (net 15 for the first invoice).

Can you send a draft change order and indicate whether Redwood needs any contract language to allow the phased ramp + temporary SLA variation? We'd like a draft we can run by legal and procurement by EOD Tuesday.

Thanks,
Lydia Ramos
VP, Engineering Operations
Aperture Analytics

Attachments: Aperture-Change-Order-Req-0504.pdf

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Lydia Ramos <lydia@aperture.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 4 May 2025 11:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: phased capacity uplift + SLA transition (change order)

Hi Lydia —

Thanks for the clear ask and for the procurement approval doc. I've attached a first-pass change order (RD-ChangeOrder-Draft-v1.docx) that mirrors what you outlined. High-level notes:

- Capacity: we added a temporary Exhibit X that increases committed GPU-hours by 400/month for Jul–Sep 2025. Ramp schedule is written as a weekly attainment table to make invoicing straightforward.
- SLA: introduced a one-time SLA variation clause limited to the defined transition window and scoped to the affected workloads; explanatory note that standard SLA resumes after cutover.
- Billing: proposed prorated invoice for July with net-15 for that invoice; subsequent invoices follow standard terms unless you confirm otherwise.

Before I send to Legal for redlines: could you confirm two things so I can bake them into the draft?
1) Do you want usage metering at job-level (per-service) included in the Exhibit? If yes, please identify the two service names.
2) Who will sign on your side (procurement or legal)? Procurement told me they will coordinate for approvals but Legal may request different language.

If you confirm the above, I'll route to our Legal/Contracts team with a request for an accelerated turnaround and flag the net-15 invoice for Finance.

Best,

--
Tessa Morgan
Principal Sales Manager
Redwood Inference
Email: tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 415-555-0192

Attachment: RD-ChangeOrder-Draft-v1.docx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 4 May 2025 14:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: quick redline suggestions for Aperture change order

Tessa / Priyom —

Looked through the draft. A few quick items I think Legal will want addressed before we send the doc to the customer:

- Price/proration: call out a clear formula for week-1 (50%) ramp billing vs full-month charge; I recommend we include an explicit proration example to avoid back-and-forth.
- Rollback & fallback: include a short fallback clause if the Dedicated capacity is unavailable for >72 hours during the transition window — this protects both sides and gives engineering an operational playbook.
- KV cache and model variant coverage: the SOW exhibit should specify whether the uplift applies to all models or only specific model IDs; that prevents over-provisioning risk.
- Termination: mark the change order as "non-termination-affecting" for the base MSA but allow Aperture to cancel the uplift with 14 days' notice subject to invoiced usage.

Priyom — can you add the recommended Exhibit table for per-service metering? If we get that in the doc, Legal can do a quick pass. Lauren — if Finance can pre-approve net-15 for the first invoice and confirm our ability to collect a deposit, that will speed sign.

I'll prepare the list of explicit contract edits (line numbers) so Legal doesn't need to parse the whole doc.

-Karthik
Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Lydia Ramos <lydia@aperture.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 May 2025 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: phased capacity uplift + SLA transition (change order)

Tessa —

Thanks, appreciate the quick turnaround. Answers below:

1) Per-service metering: yes — the two services are "pipeline-infer" and "search-rerank". Please include them in the Exhibit.
2) Signer: Procurement will sign operationally, but Legal will also review and sign off. I'll loop Legal once we have your Legal team's redlines.

Procurement also confirmed they can accept net-15 for the first invoice but asked whether Redwood can issue a deposit invoice for 20% of the uplift to secure capacity during the ramp. Can you include that option?

We'd like to aim for DocuSign by Friday 2025-05-09 if possible — our go-live window is the first week of July.

Lydia
VP, Engineering Operations
Aperture Analytics

Attachment: Aperture-Procurement-Approval.pdf

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 May 2025 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: sending to Legal + deposit option confirmed

Folks —

Per Lydia's note: they want per-service metering for pipeline-infer and search-rerank, and Procurement is OK with net-15 for the first invoice but asks if we can offer a 20% deposit invoice for the uplift.

Action items:
- Karthik: please include the per-service Exhibit table (use the template in /sales/templates/exhibit-service-metering) and add the proration example.
- Priyom: please add the fallback clause language and the 14-day cancellation option as discussed.
- Lauren: can Finance confirm we can generate a deposit invoice (20%) and that payments terms can be net-15 for the first invoice only? If Finance approves, I'll include the deposit option in the change order as alternates A/B so Legal can pick.

I'll route the revised DOCX to Legal with the subject line "APTR RD-ChangeOrder v1 — please review (expedite)" and request a 48-hour turnaround. After Legal redlines, I'll send the doc back to Lydia for review and aim to get DocuSign by Friday.

Thanks — sending the package to Legal now.
